note: A narrow gravel pull-in, listed at 12 ft wide, at the end of a 280-ft drive off the south side of Silver Lake Road, shaded, with a picnic table and fire ring. The booking page calls the driveway grade moderate; the site sits about 9 m above the road. Silver Lake Road is paved and runs between PA 402 (about 5 miles) and PA 739 (about 6.7 miles). Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: E013 CCC Camp still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 40 ft, gravel pull-in, clearance 15 ft, driveway grade Moderate. Count 1 / max 40 confirmed; pull_through false added. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; booking/hookups/season confirmed; facilities none. Phone confirmed. Imagery (leaf-on, rendered): closed mixed canopy with a brownish opening running ~40 m south of the pin; pad and road not visible. Pin = site point (0 m). 3DEP: site about 9 m above Silver Lake Road. NHD: nothing within 200 m.
flags: 'Driveway Grade: Moderate', 'Driveway Length: 280': 3DEP on the straight line from the site point north to the mapped Silver Lake Road (190 m by OSRM's snap): 406.9 m at the site, 403.5 at 47 m, 401.6 at 95 m, 399.5 at 142 m, 398.0 at the road = 8.9 m, about 5% on that line. If the driveway really is 280 ft (85 m) the pitch is steeper, up to about 10%; the mapped road line under canopy may be off. Gravel, so kept with the figure in the note.
Narrow pad: 'Site Length: 50', 'Site Width: 12'; 'This site is limited to 4 vehicles.' DCNR layer: 'Large Trailer, RV, Tent', TrailerAccess Yes.
What 'CCC Camp' is on the ground was not established: no building or clearing beyond a brownish opening shows under the canopy, and no page read describes it. The note does not claim a history.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront (NHD: nothing within 200 m).

Phone 570-895-4000 confirmed as the Delaware district office (Delaware State Forest District Office, 2391 Resica Falls Road, East Stroudsburg, PA 18302: DCNR Delaware page and camping page; '(570)895-4000' on the ReserveAmerica forest page). No change; apply.py does not write phone.
